records.trigger: Unattended orchestration retries a remedy that cannot clear the gate that blocked it, looping until killed (B-4043: 61 identical refusals vs 54 re-review rounds over 3.4 days).
records.observedFailure: evaluateScopeAntiExpansionGate refuses the same story 3 consecutive times with a byte-identical reason ('Cannot enter INIT_CHECK: scope-boundary.json is missing or invalid ... [missing_scope_boundary]'). No refusal ever carries a repeat-block marker, so nothing bounds the retry loop. gate-repeat-block-smoke exits 1 with AssertionError: 'after 3 identical refusals the breaker must trip and name the unmet precondition'.
records.note: Baseline is commit 00bba7d1b3, which contains the RED smoke only; no breaker implementation exists yet.
